about: Which kept post bears on which row of the timeline (incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/timeline.md, ids in data/signals.json). Kept by hand, read by tools/social-read.mjs, which folds each link into the post. `relation`: supports (says the same, later), precedes (says it before the time the row gives), updates (says something newer than the row), relays (an organisation repeating a body's notice), is the source of (the row was made from this post). Our reading of two texts side by side: analysis, never a fact.
